fact: Loi N°25-021/AU, promulgated by Décret N°26-023/PR of 2 February 2026, requires AI-generated or heavily modified content broadcast in the media to be labelled (art. 231), bans AI-made falsified content such as deepfakes meant to deceive or manipulate public opinion (art. 232), and sets up an AI technology and ethics watch unit at the CNPA (art. 236).
title: Décret N°26-023/PR du 2 février 2026 portant promulgation de la Loi N°25-021/AU modifiant et complétant le Code de l'Information et de la Communication
